about.label: About Us
about.heading: Connecting Farmers with Knowledge, Services and Opportunities
paragraphs: To make agricultural knowledge, timely advisory services and digital resources accessible to farmers through a unified, inclusive and collaborative platform.
BharatVistaar aims to bridge the gap between agricultural information and farmers' everyday needs by bringing together government institutions, research organisations, experts and service providers.

Through multilingual access, integrated digital services and stakeholder collaboration, the platform seeks to empower farmers with reliable information, support informed decision-making and promote sustainable agricultural practices across India.
